title: But the regenerate cannot fulfil the law perfectly
source_text: XIV. Porro, quamvis vero & commodo sensu dici possint qui spiritu Dei aguntur Dei legem implere, & ejus mandata servare, juxta Scripturae stylum & consuetudinem: multum tamen ab eo absunt, ut possint legem perfecte implere, & Dei praeceptis exactam atque omnibus numeris absolutam obedientiam praebere.
pass_a_gloss: XIV. Further, although those who are led by the spirit of God can be said in a true & fitting sense to fulfil the law of God, & to keep his commandments, according to the style & usage of Scripture: yet they are far from being able to fulfil the law perfectly, & to render to the precepts of God an exact obedience, complete in all its parts.
pass_b_english: Thesis XIV. In Scripture's way of speaking, then, those led by God's Spirit may truly and fittingly be said to fulfil God's law and keep his commandments.
Still, they are far from able to fulfil the law perfectly, or to give God's precepts an exact obedience that is complete in every part.

lemmas.gloss: in a true and fitting sense
according to the style and usage of Scripture

choices.why: Le Blanc's strict sense: satisfying the law in every respect, according to its full rigour.
